Mission Local reported that San Francisco State notified lecturers in September 2023 that their spring classes could be reduced or eliminated. The university’s budget presentation described cuts equivalent to 125 full-time positions; the faculty union said that, because most lecturers work part-time, about 300 could lose all their classes and another 600 could lose some. The story said lecturers faced the largest cuts, about a 30 percent decrease for most colleges, amid declining enrollment and a projected $9 million deficit. It also reported that lecturers and the union warned of canceled classes, lost workloads and broader effects on campus.
